name: Hester Sigerson
credit: No confirmed portrait sourced for this archive.
bio: Hester Sigerson was an Irish poet, the wife of the physician and writer George Sigerson and the mother of the poet Dora Sigerson Shorter. She contributed verse to Irish periodicals.
Yeats printed her short "Mad Song" in A Book of Irish Verse (1900).

poems.title: A Mad Song
poems.author: Hester Sigerson
poems.collection: A Book of Irish Verse, ed. W. B. Yeats (1900)
poems.text:
I hear the wind a-blowing,
I hear the corn a-growing,
I hear the Virgin praying,
I hear what she is saying.
